svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: E2B Embed: the running stack on one machine
svg.desc: An SDK client on the left reaches two ports on the machine, the api on 3000 and client-proxy on 3002, while the other nine host ports belong behind the firewall. Inside the machine, api, client-proxy and the orchestrator run on the host network above three Firecracker sandboxes and four stores bound to loopback, with a strip of one-shot steps along the bottom that runs once before any of it is usable.
svg.text: E2B Embed — what runs, and how a client reaches it
The same stack whichever way you install it: real Firecracker sandboxes, and every store on the machine's own loopback.
the REST API the SDK calls
Block them at the host firewall.
one Linux x86-64 host with /dev/kvm — its firewall is the only boundary
every port here listens on every interface of the machine
a host process, launched through nsenter by a privileged container
or from a template you built
nothing outside the machine reaches these
one-shots run once in this order; ready prints the three SDK variables
THREE WAYS TO GET THIS MACHINE
you prepare the Linux host, then run this on it
one GCE instance; its template prepares the machine
one KVM node; the pod's init containers prepare it
